description: This file defines the ProductService interface in the catalog business layer, specifying method signatures for product-related operations within the sales management system.

classes.name: ProductService
classes.description: An interface extending SalesManagerEntityService for managing Product entities, declaring methods for product description management, retrieval by various criteria, and listing products.

methods.name: addProductDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a specified product; may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: getProductDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the product description for a given product in a specified language.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Fetches a product by ID, tailored for a specific locale and language, throwing ServiceException on errors.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products within a category for a specific locale and language.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves products based on a list of category IDs.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists products associated with a specific merchant store, optionally filtered by criteria.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a new product or updates an existing product.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Gets a product by its SE (Search Engine) URL within a store for a specific locale.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its SKU/code in a specified language.
